d:
short, chin-length bob of snowy white hair with straight-cut bangs. pale lavender eyes with a solemn, vacant expression. youthful face with a mature, stoic demeanor. slender, petite athletic build. a black sleeveless dress with a high collar, white stockings, and knee-high black boots. a black blindfold-like visor covering the upper half of the face and a small white emblem on the lower back.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain skin
